page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.g6a.xlarge delivers modest performance. In stress-ng CPU tests, both single-core and multi-core performance fall into the bottom 10% tier. Similarly, memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached operations rank in the bottom 25%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, as well as in Geekbench single-core and Passmark memory tests. Multi-threaded decompression, database operations, and Redis SET operations remain in the lower performance tiers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6a.xlarge offers a budget-friendly entry point for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation rather than shared-core resources. Due to its balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio but lower overall compute and memory throughput, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate resource demands. Appropriate use cases include light web serving, basic application hosting, development and testing environments, and low-throughput database operations.
